info.name: Music API
info.description:
Functional and response-contract tests for the Music API (com.musicapi).

How to run
  1. Import db/music_db.sql into MySQL.
  2. Start the app:  ./mvnw spring-boot:run    (default port 8082)
  3. Import postman/music-api.postman_environment.json and select it.
  4. Run the collection top to bottom - folder "01 - Auth" stores the
     tokens that every later folder reuses.

Every request inherits three collection-level tests:
  * the body must use the {success, message, data} envelope
  * the success flag must agree with the HTTP status
  * the message must never contain an internal error string

Folder "99 - Error contract" holds the negative cases that previously
returned the wrong status, the wrong body shape, or a leaked message.

item.name: Unknown endpoint -> 404 in the same envelope

request.description:
A token is needed to reach the 404: Spring Security evaluates
anyRequest().authenticated() before routing, so an anonymous call to an
unknown path answers 401 rather than revealing which endpoints exist.

Documented so the 401 is not mistaken for a bug: anonymous callers
cannot probe for which endpoints exist.
